notes.reason: The note corrects a web address that Hank never said. "hangman.com/4x3" is an automatic-caption mishearing of the domain he spoke, and the same transcript shows it, because at the end of the video the captions render the address as "hankgames.com/4by3". Two different spellings of the same spoken address in one transcript is the signature of a caption error, not of an author giving out a wrong link. The note is also shaky on its own terms: it says the real address is hankgreen.com/fourbythree, which does serve the game, but it cannot know which of several short addresses Hank read out, and viewers of the video see the real URL on screen anyway. Telling a creator he published the wrong link to his own game, on the strength of a transcription slip, is exactly the kind of note that burns the relationship.
